desc: Kimber was built on the foundation of making incredibly accurate mountain rifles for enthusiasts looking for the most significant degree of accuracy. Over the last forty-five years, Kimber has etched a name for itself in the world of centerfire pistols and rifles. The Mountain Ascent legacy lives on in Kimber's Mojave and Peak rifles. Featuring an aluminum bedding block system, the new featherweight composite stocks deliver a bedrock foundation that delivers superior control and accuracy from the legacy Kimber Mountain Ascent actions. Complete with a fluted bolt body and hollow bolt knob, the latest generation of Kimber action delivers the same SUB MOA Guarantee when combined with their hyper-accurate barrels that you have come to expect from Kimber.
